go.purpose: Frei dot and calendar completion ramp

ring-count.purpose: Finished tasks in the ring centre.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Lists and panels in light mode only.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Ring fill (1100ms), theme switch, check fill.

motion.name: theme-fade
motion.purpose: Background and text colour when the theme changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink pill for the one action a task row offers.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:34px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:#1d1d1f; color:#fff; font:600 14px 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity .15s, transform .1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity:.86; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1d1d1f; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action such as Joker einsetzen or Abbrechen.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { min-height:34px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:#6e6e73; font:600 14px 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background:rgb(118 118 128 / .1); color:#1d1d1f; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1d1d1f; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Filled input for the joker reason and the reading note; focus ring in the task tint.
components.css: .ds-field { width:100%; padding:10px 12px; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:rgb(118 118 128 / .1); color:#1d1d1f; font:400 15px 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color:#2f8a4f; } .ds-field::placeholder { color:#8e8e93; } .ds-field:focus { outline:none; background:#fff; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px #2f8a4f; }

components.name: State Pill
components.description: Lock state in the top bar, dot in danger or go colour.
components.css: .ds-state { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:3px 10px 3px 8px; border-radius:999px; background:rgb(118 118 128 / .1); color:#6e6e73; font:550 12.5px 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-state::before { content:''; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:#c4161c; }

components.name: Task Row
components.description: Row in the grouped task list: tinted icon chip, title, detail, check circle.
components.html: Lesen20 Minuten, dann ein Satz dazu
components.css: .ds-task { --tint:#2f8a4f; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px; border-radius:16px; background:#fff; font-family:'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip { display:grid; place-items:center; width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:11px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--tint) 14%, transparent); color:var(--tint); } .ds-text { flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; } .ds-text strong { font-size:16px; font-weight:600; color:#1d1d1f; } .ds-text span { font-size:14px; color:#6e6e73; } .ds-check { width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:50%; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.75px rgb(118 118 128 / .18); }

narrative.overview: A calm daily checklist met in an interrupted moment. Neutral grounds, grouped lists, ink actions; colour only identifies tasks. Light and dark are equal; the page follows the system and a switch pins either.
keyCharacteristics: One segmented ring, one segment per task in its tint
One grouped list with hairline separators
Ink pills for primary actions, quiet text buttons for the rest
Monochrome history drawn as ink density

rules.name: The Task Owns Its Colour Rule
rules.body: A tint only ever marks its own task; chrome, buttons and history stay neutral.

rules.name: The No Teal Rule
rules.body: Turquoise and teal are out; the owner rejected them.

dos: Do keep colour inside the task: chip, check, ring segment, timer.
Do test both themes and 390px width before shipping.
donts: Don't wrap individual tasks in cards.
Don't put a label above the main heading.
Don't reintroduce teal or a coloured page background.
